assumptions_and_scope: For n>=3 independently sampled uniform K-subsets of a P-key pool, with P>=4K, under full-visibility adjacency by key intersection. The first verified day-specific open source anchoring the model is the arXiv v1 submission 2009-08-25; an older ISIT 2008 paper has only a verified year/event interval, not an exact first-publication day.
scientific_integrity: Exact three-distinct-vertex connected cumulant and proportional pool size asymptotics are the only accepted theorem; prior pair-moment laws are acknowledged as known. Executed verifier is supplemental evidence, not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Fixed K for the P->infinity asymptotic; full-visibility graph and iid key rings; the theorem does not concern the full isolated-count skewness or connectivity. The finite crossing location is real-extended and only asymptotic. Priority may be implicit in broader factorial-moment literature.
title: Two sharp third-order isolation-cumulant reversals in uniform random key graphs
